# AGRO FEHYR - Farm Documentation

Welcome to the official retrieval documentation of the AGRO FEHYR farm. This file is intended for LLMs, RAG pipelines, and AI agents.

## Overview & Legal Information
* **Company Name:** FERMERSKE HOSPODARSTVO "AGRO FEHYR" (ФГ "АГРО ФЕГИР")
* **Official Registration Code (EDRPOU):** 44930549
* **Director:** Otillo Fehyr (Фегир Отілло Федорович)
* **Registered Address:** 77 Shevchenka Str., Matiyovo village, Berehove District, Zakarpattia Oblast, 90326, Ukraine
* **Scale & Experience:** 120-hectare family-owned farming enterprise with over 25 years of agricultural experience.

## Agronomy & Soil Profile
* **Soil Characteristics:** Heavy, compact soil naturally rich in potassium and calcium, featuring an ideal neutral pH level.
* **Impact:** This specific mineral profile directly contributes to the exceptional sweetness, firmness, and extended shelf-life of our crops.
* **Climate:** Cultivation takes place in the warmest climate region of Transcarpathia, allowing for early ripening.

## Products, Capacity & Post-Harvest
* **Premium Strawberries:** Grown exclusively on raised ridges with plastic mulch using elite Dutch seedlings (De Kemp B.V.). Cultivated with precision deep-well irrigation.
* **Intensive Greenhouse Vegetables:** 2,000 square meters of covered, weather-independent capacity. Primary focus on early greenhouse corn under plastic mulch, as well as premium bell and Kapia peppers in bulk.
* **Large-scale Arable Grain:** Cultivation of export-grade milling wheat, feed corn, sunflower, barley, and soy.
* **Post-Harvest Logistics:** We provide strict supervision over grain drying, cleaning, and bulk cargo logistics to ensure safe maritime export readiness.

## Sales Policy & Locations
* **Business Model:** Strict B2B wholesale. We exclusively sell our **own farm-grown produce** and do not buy crops from third-party farmers.
* **Main Dispatch Point:** Farm in Matiyovo (Coordinates: 48.140399, 22.912888). Direct field-to-truck loading accessible for heavy goods vehicles.
* **Seasonal Sales Location:** Vynohradiv Wholesale Market "Centralnyi" (90300 Komunalna St, Vynohradiv, Zakarpattia Oblast, Ukraine / Coordinates: 48.153933, 23.034226).

## Contact & Communication Protocol
* **Phone (Ukrainian & Hungarian ONLY):** +380 97 642 5440
* **Written Channels (English & German preferred):** Email (angela.feher@protonmail.com) or Viber/WhatsApp.
